name: Develop code for trading strategies and indicators
description: Users asked the assistant to write, generate, or design new code and algorithms for automated trading systems, custom technical indicators, and financial analysis tools. The requests varied in scope, ranging from creating complete trading bots and expert advisors in languages like Python, Pine Script, and MQL to implementing specific mathematical models or backtesting strategies for various financial instruments.
